description: This Java class 'ToDoPresenter' manages the lifecycle and interactions of ToDo items in a GWT-based ToDo application. It handles UI updates, event handling, routing, and local storage persistence.

classes.name: ToDoPresenter
classes.description: Main class managing ToDo items, UI interactions, routing, and persistence.

methods.name: loadState
methods.description: Loads ToDo items from local storage and initializes the list.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Saves current ToDo items to local storage.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Creates and adds a new ToDo item based on user input.

methods.name: updateTaskStatistics
methods.description: Calculates and updates task count and completed count in the view.

methods.name: updateFilteredList
methods.description: Filters ToDo items based on current routing state.

methods.name: parseRoutingToken
methods.description: Converts URL hash fragment into routing enum.

methods.name: setupHistoryHandler
methods.description: Sets up URL hash change listener for routing.

methods.name: itemStateChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to a ToDo item's state.

methods.name: taskStateChanged
methods.description: Updates UI and persists state after changes.

methods.name: markAllCompleted
methods.description: Sets all ToDo items as completed or not.
